item.title: Mental health update, I'm still trying y'all
item.description:
And my hair was greasy and pretty sure I had coffe breath
I really had no thoughts of flirting I was just hyped about beef prices and being honest how the 5lb ground beef logs at Smiths used to be $12 and now they are $27
Of all the things I coulda bragged I saved money on I talked about my pads and tampon haul at a CVS years ago. It was a great haul though cause I was able to donate to my high school and a neighbor with daughters
I will not burden ANYONE with the baggage of healing I still gotta do on my own.
Im sure I left him speechless but if he said anything I don't know cause I scurried away.
Feels like I am drowning but I am still somehow floating along through these days to get through the holidays. I got my followup orthopedic appointment to go over MRI results and trying to figure out where to afford to live cause I don't want to be in Vegas anymore. I want to live in a place I have never had trauma even if Vegas is awesome and better to me than France was.
Goddamn it was nice to have a man approach, be normal and kind, not run away, and seem genuine.
Sorry for all the insta vids I've just been keeping off imgur for a while and trying to still watch positive uplifting confidence building videos. God I need to try a fine Scottish man. Always wanted to visit Scotland for years. I should have just booked a trip to Scotland when I had the money and time instead of choosing to follow love and a man online
I have an appointment to see if I qualify for any mortgage loan so I can buy a tiny place in the middle of nowhere to get away from everyone and cause Vegas is too FUCKING EXPENSIVE TO LIVE. I know realistically I won't qualify for jack shit cause most lenders require at least 2 years stable job income and I quit my job to be with a dumb lying fuck so hopefully the mortgage lender can lend me good info and advice if nothing else
If anyone is in a toxic unhappy relationship, if whatever dinamic you both agreed upon isn't working after clear communications about wants, needs, and results, please just separate because life is too short to be with a mediocre human who doesn't want to grow and is okay with causing you pain time after time with lies. MAN OR WOMAN. If your partner keeps lying, or hiding things, and is causing more stress in your life after multiple chances, please LEAVE. THAT IS NOT LOVE. THAT IS INFATUATION, DELUSION, SELF ABSORBTION, AND ABUSE
And now some wholesomeness to end the week and start anew I still haven't responded to all my dm's. Sorry everyone.

item.title: Confirmed! Zelenskyy confirms Ukrainian naval drone strikes on Russian ships in the Mediterranean
item.description: Zelensky: "An exemplary Ukrainian operation in response to Russia’s war. I thank the warriors of the Security Service of Ukraine and all our Defense Forces of Ukraine who took part in carrying out these tasks. I received detailed briefings on the operation’s steps yesterday and today – the targets we set were achieved. It all took place off the coast of Libya. Our warriors deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones. Despite all the enemy’s efforts to counter the attack, the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk. It’s one of their newest ships, commissioned in 2023, during the full-scale war. A Ka-27 combat helicopter was also destroyed along with the corvette. Our second target was the Russian dry cargo vessel MV ANGARA, which the enemy used to transport weapons. Result: target hit. We continue our operations in designated waters. We are responding to Russia’s aggression. We are developing Ukrainian weapons. Glory to Ukraine!" Additional: "Our exemplary Ukrainian operation in response to Russia’s war. Thank you to the warriors of the Security Service of Ukraine and all our Ukrainian Defense Forces who were involved in carrying out these missions. Yesterday and today, I received detailed reports on the operation’s progress—the designated targets were hit. Everything took place off the coast of Libya. Our warriors deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones. Despite all the enemy’s efforts to counter them, the Russian corvette Mercury was sunk. It is one of their newest ships, commissioned during the full-scale war in 2023. A Ka-27 attack helicopter was also destroyed along with the corvette. Our second target was the Russian dry cargo ship MV ANGARA, which the enemy was using to transport weapons. Result: hit. We continue operations in designated maritime areas. We are responding to Russia’s aggression. We are developing Ukrainian weapons. Glory to Ukraine!" Adding a quick personal note, referring to an earlier post of mine: "he Russian cargo ship targeted yesterday was ANGARA, not ASCALON. The two vessels are almost identical sister ships, with virtually the same length, beam, gross tonnage and overall design. Both are Ro-Ro cargo vessels belonging to the same class, making them very similar in appearance and specifications." (as always thanks to: @InsiderGeo)

item.title: GovBrief Today #661
item.description: Donald Trump hosted a dinner tonight for the biggest buyers of his cryptocurrency, and one of the invitations went for $518. It was the third event he has held for the largest holders of $TRUMP, the digital coin he started selling three days before his second inauguration. The first was a dinner at his Virginia golf club in May 2025. Announcing it nearly doubled the coin's price. A seat took at least $55,000 in coins, and the top guest, the crypto billionaire Justin Sun, held $18.5 million. When tonight's dinner at the same club was announced in September, the price did not change. The Washington Post found more than 5,000 people who owned enough to qualify and never filled out the form, even after the organizers gave them four extra days. The holders on this year's list had $8.6 million between them, less than half of what Sun held by himself at the first dinner. A coin that once cost $74 now costs less than $1, and Trump's own disclosure says it has paid his family at least $635 million. He told the room tonight, "I'm doing it for the United States." On February 1, 2025, I typed a list of nine things I never imagined a government doing in one day and sent it to my family. I've sent one every night since: 10,057 stories over 661 straight nights, free and without ads. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I'll send it to you too. Subscribe free: https://gbounacos.substack.com/subscribe Sneak peek: Trump's DC Makeover maps 17 places Donald Trump has renamed, rebuilt, remade, or proposed changing in his second term, most of them in Washington, and shows where each one stands today. item.title: A Ukrainian sea baby destroys a russian cargo vessel near Libya.
item.description:
Footage filmed from a Libyan National Army Air Force helicopter shows a Ukrainian surface drone hitting a Russian military-linked cargo vessel off Benghazi earlier.
Boom shaka laka. Second ship in one day. I guess Putin has a headache today.
Between October 15 and 16, @InsiderGeo and @SONARROW_OSINT observed the Russian cargo vessels ASCALON (IMO 9198226), LADY D (IMO 9349289) and ANASTASIIA (IMO 9349291) loading significant quantities of military equipment at the Kaliningrad naval base, including logistics vehicles, infantry vehicles, MRAPs and troop transports. A rotation of other cargo vessels also appears to have taken place in the days before and after, although heavy cloud cover over the period makes this difficult to confirm. One or more large convoys are likely already underway. Their destination(s) remain unknown at this time.
The imagery shows ANASTASIIA and YURIY ARSHENEVSKIY alongside the Ropucha-class landing ship ALEKSANDR SHABALIN. A large number of military and logistics vehicles can be seen in the port area, including multiple Ural-type trucks arranged in rows. The imagery provides a much clearer view of the equipment previously identified aboard the convoy and appears to show the vehicles being unloaded and brought ashore at Tobruk.

item.title: Finally
item.description: I dont celebrate my birthday, but apparently people dont understand that I DO NOT CARE about my birthday. Its usually a bad month for me, lots of hurt and bad memories in November, and my birthday has a lot of trauma attached to it. My family never celebrated my birthday I was assaulted on my birthday as a "gift" (I finally reported it about 6 years ago, happened in my teens) And I personally view it as just another day. And I would personally like that to be respected. Lucky enough, I had to work, close and do paperwork. It was a Saturday and I hate my local bar on the weekends, too many people, too many drunks, too much noise. So my sister texted me she loves me, no mention of birthday. A couple of my friends and coworkers mentioned it but left it alone and moved on (one of my employees actually asked me to not mention theirs as well). My roommates have said nothing (they know the deal). I cut off my family full stop last year, and for the first time in my life, it was just a day. Another age, another day, no drinks, no cake, no songs, nothing. No shitty texts, personal conversations, no pain to bandage. Just a happy Saturday, same as the others. And now im 37. Edit: i do celebrate my 2nd birthday, my Tranniversary. Its January 24. Ill be 4 this year!
